title: Quotient projections separate a completed finite tensor
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal. Put $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $\mathfrak m$ its maximal ideal and $C=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Write $E_n:C\otimes_R S\to(A/\mathfrak m^n)\otimes_R S$ for the tensor product of the canonical quotient evaluation with the identity of $S$ [def-weil-module-base-change]. For every $x\in C\otimes_R S$, if $E_n(x)=0$ for all $n\geq0$, then $x=0$.

source.place: Tag 07N9, separation of completed tensors; Tags 0316, 05GG, 05GI, 00DF and 00IQ

proof.text: Localization makes A Noetherian; Tag 0316 makes C Noetherian, and local completion makes C local with maximal ideal mC. Base change of the finite R-module S makes T=C tensor_R S finite over C.

The module and ring quotient evaluations of C are identified by the quotient equivalence. The kernel formula of Tag 05GG at every power gives ker(C -> A/m^n)=m^n C. Right exactness of tensor product extends this kernel to T. Thus E_n(x)=0 puts x in (mC)^n T.
The maximal ideal of C lies in its Jacobson radical. Apply Krull intersection to the finite C-module T: membership in every power forces x=0.

theorem completion_tensor_quotient_separated
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let C := AdicCompletion m A
    ∀ x : C ⊗[R] S,
      (∀ n : ℕ, Algebra.TensorProduct.map ((evalₐ m n).restrictScalars R)
        (AlgHom.id R S) x = 0) → x = 0
